answers.core: It will be a core datatype
answers.workaround:
StringName is exposed in 4.0 onwards, it needs first class support to get used more often.
I am creating an Array of StringNames like this,

```gdscript
var str_array :Array[StringName] = []
# or 
var str_array :Array[StringName]
```
but when you `push_back()` it takes the parameter as `Variant`. It does not give confidence.
I did a quick perf test on the working project

**System:**

> Godot Engine v4.2.dev6.official.57a6813bb - https://godotengine.org
Vulkan API 1.3.242 - Forward Mobile - Using Vulkan Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti
AMD Ryzen 7 5800X 8-Core Processor (3.80 GHz) - RAM (32.0 GB)

** Code:**
```gdscript
func perf_test_string_name_vs_int():
	const ITERATIONS = 100_000
	
	var str_name_array: Array[StringName] = []
	var int_array: Array[int] = []
	var packed_int_array: PackedInt64Array = PackedInt64Array()
	
	var start_time: int = 0
	var time_taken: int = 0
	
	print("# STRING NAME - ARRAY")
	start_time = Time.get_ticks_usec()
	#enumerate_children(str_array, self)
	for i in ITERATIONS:
		str_name_array.push_back(StringName("GameBoard%s" % i))
	time_taken = Time.get_ticks_usec() - start_time
	#print("Total number of Nodes: ", str_array.size()  )
	print("Time Taken(Creation): %s usec:" % time_taken )
	
	start_time = Time.get_ticks_usec()
	str_name_array.has(&"GameBoard56")
	time_taken = Time.get_ticks_usec() - start_time
	print("Time Taken(Search- Positive): %s usec:" % time_taken )
	
	start_time = Time.get_ticks_usec()
	str_name_array.has(&"Something")
	time_taken = Time.get_ticks_usec() - start_time
	print("Time Taken(Search- Negative): %s usec:" % time_taken )
	
	print("# INT - Array")
	
	start_time = Time.get_ticks_usec()
	for i in ITERATIONS:
		int_array.push_back(i)
	time_taken = Time.get_ticks_usec() - start_time
	print("Time Taken(Creation): %s usec:" % time_taken )
	
	start_time = Time.get_ticks_usec()
	int_array.has(100)
	time_taken = Time.get_ticks_usec() - start_time
	print("Time Taken(Search - Positive): %s usec:" % time_taken )
